node.title: Re^3: Scrape Select Options from Web Page
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I think, possibly because the page designer doesn't have an explicit <form> tag in the page.

Yes, it does appear that [mod://WWW::Mechanize] requires the

tags to recognize inputs. By your reply to [id://1215908|my other solution], I assume you've already figured out that you can feed the HTML to [mod://Mojo::DOM] with e.g. my $dom = Mojo::DOM->new($mech->content);.
